Custom Embroidery That Commands Respect and Recognition

When your logo is embroidered on a polo shirt, people notice the difference. The raised threads, the premium texture, the undeniable quality—custom embroidery doesn't just display your brand, it elevates it. ImageOn transforms ordinary garments into professional statements that communicate excellence before you say a word.

Why Custom Embroidery Builds Stronger Brands Than Printing

Custom embroidery creates a three-dimensional impact that flat printing simply cannot match. The texture catches light, the threads add depth, and the durability ensures your brand message remains crisp through countless washes and years of wear. While printed designs fade and crack, embroidered logos maintain their professional appearance, protecting your brand investment.

Texture That Tells Your Brand's Quality Story

Every embroidered thread communicates attention to detail. When customers see embroidered uniforms, they unconsciously associate your business with quality and permanence. This psychological impact translates into increased trust and perceived value for your products or services.

Durability That Protects Your Brand Investment

ImageOn's custom embroidery withstands industrial washing, daily wear, and time itself. Your brand message remains vibrant and professional long after printed alternatives have faded, ensuring consistent brand representation that protects your reputation.

How ImageOn Delivers Embroidery Excellence Without Compromise

Frequently Asked Questions

ImageOn Embroidery Services serving Carmel Mountain

Image On is your local print shop serving Carmel Mountain that handles every aspect of Embroidery from digitizing to production. We do all the work in-house. Here are some common questions people ask:

How much do we charge for embroidery?

  • Our prices change based on what you need. We look at how many items you want, what kind of items they are, and how detailed your design is.
  • Good news, if you order a lot, we'll give you a discount!
  • Want to know exactly how much? Just give us a call at (619) 312-0941, and we'll figure it out for you.

How long will your order take?

  • Usually, we can get your order done in 5 to 7 business days.
  • In a rush? No problem! We can speed things up to 1-3 days for a little extra.
  • Need it today? We can even do same-day service if you're really in a bind.

Do we have a minimum order?

  • Nope! We're happy to do just one item, or we can handle orders up to 10,000 if you need that many.
  • Remember, the more you order, the better deal we can give you.

Can we handle rush orders?

  • Absolutely! We're used to last-minute requests.
  • We're here from 9 AM to 7 PM to help you out.
  • If you need something urgently, just call us at (619) 312-0941.

A few more things about us:

  • Don't have a design ready for embroidery? No worries, we can help prepare it (we call this digitizing).
  • We can put embroidery on all sorts of things - hats, shirts, jackets, you name it!

At Image On, we're ready for any project, big or small. Want a single shirt with your grandma's dog on it? We can do that. Need a bunch of hats for your business? We've got you covered. Whatever you need, we're here to help make it happen!
